title: Festbiss – Video-Ad 13 (DE) · „Was unter Ihrer Prothese passiert“ – Whiteboard-Erklärvideo
format: Whiteboard explainer: one opening shot of the Italian prosthodontist at a whiteboard, then a close-up of his hand (navy scrubs sleeve) drawing simple marker diagrams – denture, ridge, gap, adhesive, gel – with German hand-lettered labels; product shot at the end. Long scenes (8–25 s) with the drawing building up.
voice_note: Male VO (the prosthodontist), German with a light Italian accent, calm, clear, teacher-like. Address: Sie.
captions_note: White bold sans with a soft black shadow, 2–4 words, centered in the lower middle. S01: red header box with white text at the top. Green round 60-day badge top right in S13–S14.
